product_launches.description: Turneo launched Neo, an AI-powered agent platform acting as a digital concierge for hotels across channels like web chat, email and WhatsApp.

overview_description.description: Turneo is a traveltech company that provides an experience booking platform for hotels and resorts. It allows guests to browse and book all of their holiday activities, directly via hotel or resort website. At the same time, staff are able to see and manage experience bookings seamlessly, with Turneo's intuitive Agent Tool, while hotel managers are equipped with the tools they need to understand, build, and grow their experience offer. With no complex integration and zero setup fee, hotels can start growing their experience offer in less than a week.

about_short_description.short_description: Turneo is a B2B platform that enables travel brands to offer and manage in-destination experiences for their guests.

product.name: Turneo Experiences Platform
product.description: A B2B platform that enables hotels and travel brands to publish, sell, book, and manage in-destination experiences across guest-facing and staff channels.

product.name: Turneo AI Agents
product.description: AI tools that assist hotel teams with experience marketing, recommendations, communications, itinerary creation, and operational tasks.

product.name: Experience Store and Booking Engine
product.description: A branded, embeddable storefront that lets hotel guests browse and book in-house and local experiences through websites, apps, messaging, and APIs.

product.name: Experience Management System
product.description: A centralized system for configuring experiences, pricing, schedules, capacity, resources, properties, partners, commissions, payouts, and performance reports.

product.name: Concierge Booking System
product.description: A staff-facing booking tool for checking availability, making or changing reservations, charging rooms or cards, sending payment links, and creating guest itineraries.

product.name: Partner and Guest Support Services
product.description: Operational support for coordinating experience partners and assisting guests with experience-related bookings and service requests.
